create.name: Laura Ahrens
create.bio:
Laura Ahrens is a yoga teacher and scholar of Indian religion whose classes put philosophy at the centre of practice. She came to yoga after training in theatre, then studied Sanskrit and Indian thought for a master's degree at Rutgers, and she is now a doctoral candidate in religion at the University of Florida, where her research centres on yoga and Hindu traditions. Alongside that academic work she holds certification as a yoga therapist through the International Association of Yoga Therapists and has taught continuously for around fifteen years. For some years she ran The New School of Yogic Arts, a teacher training that leaned heavily on the classical texts.

Her teaching treats the mat as a mirror: posture, breath and meditation are used to see habits of mind clearly, and the texts are read slowly and in context rather than as slogans. She runs an online membership with monthly live classes and a large archive of recordings, and a yearlong immersion that works through the Yoga Sutras, the Bhagavad Gita and the Hatha Yoga Pradipika with practical application. She values community as a support for steady practice, and she leads weekend programmes at Kripalu and occasional in-person workshops and retreats in New England.

courses.title: Yoga for Vitality: A Weekend of Movement, Breath, and Meditation for Deep Renewal
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, built on four strands: postural practice, pranayama, meditation and yogic philosophy. Each session is meant to leave participants with simple practices they can keep using at home; an online option is also offered.

courses.title: Steadfast Sādhanā Yearlong Immersion
courses.description: A year of mostly weekly online sessions through 2027 that read the Yoga Sutras, the Bhagavad Gita and the Hatha Yoga Pradipika closely, with Laura's notes on the Sanskrit. Study is paired with guidance on building a daily practice, and every session is recorded for the members' portal.

courses.title: Laura Ahrens Yoga Membership
courses.description: An online membership with live virtual classes each month and an archive of several hundred recorded classes. Financial help is available on request.
courses.price: $30 USD per month or $120 USD per six months
